root_cause.text: Integer overflow in the volume boundary check `lcn + len > sbi->used.bitmap.nbits` within `run_unpack()` in fs/ntfs3/run.c, where unsanitized `lcn` and `len` values can cause the addition to wrap around, bypassing the validation and allowing out-of-volume LCN ranges.
root_cause.evidence: The patch replaces the raw addition `lcn + len` with `check_add_overflow(lcn, len, &lcn_end)` to detect overflow before comparing against `sbi->used.bitmap.nbits`. The CVE description explicitly states that "the volume boundary check ... uses raw addition which can wrap around for large lcn and len values, bypassing the validation."
